newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares up on renewed optimism.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares up on renewed optimism.

text.p: Slovenian shares jumped 4.78 percent on Friday, going some way to reversing the week's losses, and traders sensed renewed optimism in the market.
Market participants said investors were looking for a fresh inflow of foreign investors.
* The SBI index rose 54.43 points to 1,192.3.
* Turnover rose to 525.5 million tolars from 382.3 million.
* Bank SKB was the most actively traded and the biggest gainer, firming 11.17 percent to 40,100 tolars. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
